name: East Asian Studies
about: East Asian Studies is an interdisciplinary major for students who wish to develop expertise in the cultures, histories, and societies of China, Japan, and Korea. The major combines training in an East Asian language with course work across the humanities and social sciences, including history, literature, art, religion, political science, economics, and anthropology. Students are encouraged to study abroad in East Asia. The major provides a strong foundation for careers in international affairs, business, law, journalism, academia, and other fields that require knowledge of East Asia. The program draws on the rich resources of Yale's Council on East Asian Studies and the extensive East Asian collections of the Yale University Library.
